title: SBI identifies Rs 10,000 Cr agri loan pool for restructuring across three drought hit states; uptake likely to be limited
summary: State Bank of India has identified a potential agricultural loan portfolio of around Rs 10,000 crore for restructuring across three states that have declared drought, with the actual uptake depending on farmers opting for the facility and giving their consent. Chairman C S Setty said the bank's past experience suggests that not many borrowers avail of such restructuring.
